description: This file defines functions for setting and getting user-defined field selectors in the RTL8367C switch hardware, including register access and parameter validation.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_setAsicFieldSelector(rtk_uint32 index,rtk_uint32 format,rtk_uint32 offset)
methods.description: Sets the user-defined field selector at a specified index with given format and offset, with parameter validation and register writing.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_getAsicFieldSelector(rtk_uint32 index,rtk_uint32 * pFormat,rtk_uint32 * pOffset)
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration of a specified field selector index, reading from hardware register and outputting format and offset values.
